name: Paperclip AI Company HQ
description: Run a team of AI agents with goals, budgets and org charts.

PORT.description: Port the Paperclip server listens on; the public domain targets it.

HOST.description: Listen on all interfaces so Railway's edge and private network can reach the server.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string on the private network (replaces the embedded database).

PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE.description: Login required (Better Auth). Never use local_trusted on a public URL.

PAPERCLIP_DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE.description: Upstream's appliance mode: enables the browser 'Claim this instance' first-admin flow and the hostname allow-list.

PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Canonical public URL for auth callbacks, invite links and the hostname allow-list. Change it when you add a custom domain.

PAPERCLIP_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES.description: Extra hostnames accepted by the private-host guard: Railway's healthcheck and the private network. The public URL host is added automatically.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Session signing secret for Better Auth (generated).

PAPERCLIP_AGENT_JWT_SECRET.description: Signing secret for short-lived agent API tokens (generated, kept separate from the session secret).

PAPERCLIP_TOOL_ACTION_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Signs tool-action approvals. Without it approvals cannot be issued (generated).

PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY.description: 32-byte (64 hex) key encrypting company secrets in Postgres. Back it up; losing it makes stored secrets unreadable.

PAPERCLIP_MIGRATION_AUTO_APPLY.description: Apply database migrations automatically on start and upgrade.

PAPERCLIP_AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED.description: Rate-limit sign-in attempts (off by default in private mode upstream).

TRUST_PROXY.description: Trust exactly one proxy hop (Railway's edge) for client IPs used by rate limiting.

PAPERCLIP_STORAGE_PROVIDER.description: Store attachments and uploads in the Railway Bucket instead of the volume.

PAPERCLIP_STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint of the Railway Bucket (virtual-hosted style).

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Bucket access key (read by the AWS SDK).

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Bucket secret key (read by the AWS SDK).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets claude_local agents run with an API key; alternatively run `claude` login via Railway SSH (stored on the volume).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Lets codex_local agents run with an API key; alternatively `codex login --device-auth` via Railway SSH.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Gemini API key (must be restricted to the Gemini API) for gemini_local agents.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Lets running heartbeats and agent processes stop cleanly on redeploy.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down
